registry_contract.dependencies: G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-106, reference compiler, Fourfold relation digests, KnowledgeForest

migration_and_rollback.projection_note: Rollback removes this research record and the focused assertions it cites. The packet adds no production code path, projection authority, cache, public API or persisted runtime state, so there is nothing else to migrate or revert.

title: Reuse the producer-local relation digest without creating a second authority

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit where canonical Forest relation digests are already computed, then delete duplicate producer-local hashing where the exact digest-to-edge association is naturally live. Do not persist or publish a new digest index, receipt family, cache, or graph authority.

audit.legacy_forest: fourfold_from_knowledge_forest already computes one edge digest inside the projection loop and immediately reuses it for same-plane relation membership or cross-plane binding evidence; no duplicate producer-local edge hash was found there.
audit.reference_compiler_before: compile_reference_project hashed each ForestEdge payload once as the deterministic Forest ordering tie-breaker, then hashed each retained same-plane edge payload again while building PlaneSnapshot.relation_sha256s.
audit.gate1_boundary: ReferenceCompileResult still intentionally returns the authoritative Forest and Fourfold snapshot without a persistent digest-to-edge index. The compile-local association is discarded at the result boundary, so GPU-106's later changed-digest-to-edge lookup limitation is not claimed solved.

implementation.change: Materialize compile-local (ForestEdge, canonical_digest) rows once, sort the Forest with the same digest tie-breaker, and reuse the exact digest for same-plane Fourfold relation membership.

deterministic_contract_result.edge_payload_hash_rule: Within compile_reference_project, the focused fixture observes exactly one reference_compiler.canonical_sha call for each ForestEdge payload; retained same-plane relation membership reuses that digest instead of hashing the payload again.
deterministic_contract_result.semantic_guard: The resulting Fourfold snapshot remains bound to the exact KnowledgeForest content digest.
deterministic_contract_result.scope_limit: KnowledgeForest.content_sha256 still serializes/hashes the complete Forest identity, and later independent authority consumers may still need their own verification hash. GPU-107 only removes the duplicate producer-local canonical edge digest calculation.

decision.finding: There is a safe Gardener win before any new incremental schema: retain the digest-to-edge association only inside the existing reference compile call long enough to reuse it. Do not export it as a new persistent authority merely to accelerate later Tensor work.
unsafe_shortcuts_rejected: new public digest receipt solely for performance
trusting sorted relation_sha256s as positional edge identity

verification.kind: focused deterministic hash-count contract plus existing Fourfold/Tensor integration workflow

claim_boundaries: No claim that GPU-107 provides O(delta) changed-edge lookup after compile_reference_project returns.
No latency or memory superiority claim; the retained evidence is a deterministic duplicate-hash elimination contract, not a benchmark win.
No Tensor-vs-Forest, GPU/Tensor-Core, CrewAI or AlphaEvolve superiority claim.
No OwnerApproval, PromotionReceipt, merge, Ready-for-Review or Gate transition.
next_bounded_step: GPU-108 should measure the remaining end-to-end duplicate relation hashing across the existing reference compile -> Gate-1 before/after -> compile_relation_blocks path after this producer-local deletion. Only if a revision-bound association would eliminate a material measured cost should an existing result contract be considered for extension; otherwise retain stateless re-verification and avoid a new receipt/index abstraction.
